paite: Huchi in na lak ua saptuam upate kei na upatpih uh, Khrist thuaknate theipa leh thupina hong lang ding tang sam ding in hiai bang in ka hon hanthawn hi:
heading: Upate Leh Tuailaite
english: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

paite: Na lak ua Pathian belamhonte ching unla, enkol un, sawl teitei ziak hilou in, Pathian hon deihna bang hi zaw in, punna thanghuai deih ziak hilou in, kithalawptak zaw in,
english: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

paite: na tante uh tung ah kiliansak tuan lou in belamhonte zuih ding a kibawl zaw in, kem un.
english: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

paite: Huchi in Belamchingpa lianpen ahong lat chiang in, Thupina Lallukhu tul thei lou na mu ding uhi.
english: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

paite: Huchi mah bang in, nou valnoute aw, upate nuai ah lut un. Ahi, na vek ua nna kisepsaktuah chiat ding in thunuailutna in kithuam un; "Pathian in kisatheite adou a, kingaineute bel hehpihna ape nak hi."
english: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

paite: Huaiziak in ahuntak a nou ahon pahtawi theihna ding in, Pathian khut hattak nuai ah kihihniam un;
heading: Thuhilhna Vantang
english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

paite: ama'n ahon limsak gige ziak in na mangbatna tengteng uh amah tung ah nga vek un.
english: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

paite: Pilvang unla, limsak un; na melma uh diabol, humpinelkai humham bang in anawmvalh ding zong in avialvak hi.
english: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

paite: Na unau uh khovel a omte tung ah huchibang thuaknate atung sam chih thei in gingkiptak a om in, amah dou un.
english: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

paite: Huan hehpihna tengteng Pathian, atangtawn thupina tang ding a Khrist a nou hon sampa ngei in, sawt lou kal na thuak nung un ahoih bukim a hon bawl in, hon hihkip in, ahon hihhat ding hi.
english: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

paite: Amah kiang ah vaihawmna tangtawn in om hen, Amen.
english: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Ka unaupa muanhuaitak Silvanas khut in, noumau hanthawn leh huai Pathian hehpihna taktak ahi chih thei in, tomchik in na kiang uah ka gelh ahi; huaite ah dingkip un.
english: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

paite: Babulon a om noumau bang a telnu'n chibai ahon buk hi; huchibang in ka tapa Marka in leng chibai ahon buk ahi.
english: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

paite: Itna kitawpna a tawp in chibai kibuk un, na lak ua Khrist a om peuhmahte kiang ah khamuanna om hen, Amen.
english: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
